entities.summary: Tseung Kwan O Chinese Permanent Cemetery, also referred to as Junk Bay Chinese Permanent Cemetery is a cemetery in Tiu Keng Leng, Hong Kong. It is managed by The Board of Management of the Chinese Permanent Cemeteries (華人永遠墳場管理委員會). The term 'Permanent' refers to the cemetery site, not the graves.
